replace.k: Daughter of Leslie Dean of the Church of Gibborim
st: Without her church bracelet, Karolina glows with light; she learns Jonah is her father.
Kidnapped by Jonah, then on the run, Karolina falls for Nico, meets Xavin, and is captured by Jonah's family.
Karolina escapes Jonah's prison and fights Morgan le Fay with her friends.

notes.change: Runaways S1–S2 second step: status Fugitive -> Imprisoned; sentence now ends with her capture by Jonah's family.
notes.why: In the season 2 finale ("Split Up") Jonah's family captures Karolina with Chase and Janet and holds them in stasis; Runaways S3 opens with her escaping that prison, so she was not still on the run at the end of S1–S2.
